gameDescriptionHtml:
Planet: Voidregula 6.
Hazard class: Not assigned
Scan result: Suitable for colonization. Terraform with caution!
Status: Prepared, the first stage of settlement is underway.
Problem: Communication with the planet is completely interrupted. We are sending an expedition.

A mix of roguelike shooter and survival on an unknown planet, featuring persistent progress and a cozy hub. Attempt to unravel the mysteries of what has happened by exploring stations, dungeons, canyons, swamps, and permafrost, while battling alien creatures.

Game Features

  • Adrenaline shooter. Each enemy is a mortal danger. Caution, reaction and aim are as important as a saved ammo and an extra explosion that raises the alarm in the den of creatures.
  • At night it’s more dangerous. Survival with elements of horror. Stock up on oxygen, flashlight batteries and ammo in advance to have a chance of surviving another night.
  • Wide range of weapons and equipment. Pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, machine guns, grenade launchers, katanas, night vision, energy shields, sound absorption, weapon upgrades and more.
  • Combos and progression. Recipes for unique weapons. Enhancements that transform your character. Shops and secret rooms throughout the levels. Weapon upgrades in the hub.
  • Solo or co-op up to 4 players. Play shoulder to shoulder, protect your teammates’ rear and share resources.
